description: Open-source project management вЂ” issues, cycles, modules, sub-issues, and workspaces. A self-hostable Jira/Linear/ClickUp alternative.

novel_features.name: Issue Relations
novel_features.description: Flat list/set/unset of issue blocking, blocked_by, duplicate, relates_to and temporal links without hand-driving the relations endpoint (unset bridges Plane CE's missing DELETE via a configurable Django-shell call).

novel_features.name: Module Membership & Sync Enrichment
novel_features.description: Manage an issue's module membership (of/create-issue/sync) and auto-enrich issue module_ids during sync (on by default), since Plane's issue API never returns module membership.

novel_features.name: Cycle Plan
novel_features.description: Preview and atomically add an explicitly validated selection of work items to a cycle, with live selection and readback and automatic selection that excludes every item already assigned to any cycle.

novel_features.name: Cycle Health
novel_features.description: Read live cycle, work-item, state, and blocker data to report bounded cycle health without mutating Plane.

novel_features.name: Cycle Rollover
novel_features.description: Preview unfinished work from a source cycle, transfer it atomically to a target cycle, and verify the result from live source and target readback.

novel_features.name: Backlog Triage
novel_features.description: Read and rank a bounded live backlog for planning while keeping triage strictly read-only and separate from mutation.

novel_features.name: Backlog Apply
novel_features.description: Preview explicit backlog updates, apply them only with mutation confirmation, and normalize live server representations before verifying the requested changes.

novel_features.name: Project Health
novel_features.description: Read bounded live project, cycle, work-item, and state data to summarize delivery health without mutating Plane.

novel_features.name: Blockers
novel_features.description: Inspect a bounded live relation fan-out and report blocking work-item relationships without mutating Plane.
